name: PhishGuard - Email Phishing Detector
description: Real-time phishing detection for Gmail. Spots spoofed senders, scans links via VirusTotal & detects phishing patterns. Free.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src https://www.virustotal.com; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'
